data: You throw a solid piece of stone at a creature in an attempt to bring them to the ground. Make a ranged attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a hit, any "Raised" creature is knocked prone and loses its flying speed and immunity to ground-type moves until it can move again. This move can target creatures in the invulnerable stage of Fly or Bounce.
Badly startles Pokémon that the audience has high expectations of.
Pokemon that has the highest Visual Round score must make a CHA Saving Throw against Intimidation/Persuasion DC.
